text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Hmm, it's about time for training, but...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Guess I'll head out once I've organized 
these documents.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Now then, all done. Is there anything else 
left to do—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Hm, come to think of it, I haven't looked 
over the documents for tomorrow's meeting 
yet.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Might as well. Guess I'll give it a 
read...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Is there a way to distill this into 
something more memorable...?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
If I review the materials once more and 
trim away the excess, perhaps...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: However, we might not have the time...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
No, at the very least, I must finish this 
one sentence, no matter what!

By the time she wrapped up her work at a 
good stopping point, our training time had 
long since passed...
